restrictions: Draw q = 2^129 messages, each a single 55-byte string whose 440-bit content is an independent uniform draw from the algorithm's own randomness; hash each with fixed-IV SHA-256 rounds 0 through 30 on the one resulting padded block, full feed-forward, full 256-bit digest. Each hash is exactly one target compression because a 55-byte message pads to a single 512-bit block; no second block is processed.

Detect duplicate digests with an eight-pass 32-bit-digit LSD radix sort of three-word (256-bit-key, content-hi, content-lo) records over two pre-allocated q-record arrays and a 2^32-slot count array, then an adjacent-pair scan; require distinct messages and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing. Report FAIL if no adjacent duplicate is found.

Success probability is over the algorithm's own uniform content draws for the single fixed target function; no random-mapping, random-oracle, or ensemble assumption is used. By the distribution-free birthday lemma (uniform inputs give pairwise key-collision probability C = sum_y p(y)^2 >= 1/2^256, minimized by uniform p), Pr(all q keys distinct) <= exp(-q(q-1)/(2*2^256)) = exp(-(2 - 2^-128)) < 0.13535, so Pr(success) > 0.86 after subtracting the 2^-183 identical-content chance. This is unconditional and distribution-free.

Total charged time summed explicitly: (q + 2) compressions = 2^129*(1 + 2^-128) units, plus at most (208 q + 2^36)/2140 < 0.0972*2^129 + 2^25.4 non-compression units (per-record envelope 64 generation + 128 for eight radix passes + 16 scan = 208 word operations, which is below C = 2140), plus under 2^20 preprocessing units, totalling below 2^129.134 units. Hence time_log2 = 130 is a valid upper bound with about a 1.82x margin.

Memory is a hard pre-allocated maximum, not an expectation: two q-record arrays (192 q bytes) plus the 2^32-slot count array (2^37 bytes) plus fixed scratch under 2^20 bytes, below 2^137 total. preprocessing is inside total time; nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes = 0 reflects zero actual advice, no precomputed collision, and no favorable seed. This uses no property of the round reduction and claims no improvement over the nominal reference.
